UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile records containing account credentials, role, and active workspace mapping.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Full name or business persona display name.

photoURL.description: Avatar URL of the user profile.

activeWorkspaceId.description: Identifier of the currently selected business workspace.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp when the profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp when the profile was last modified.

Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Business workspace containing CRM configuration, team parameters, and pixel tracking settings.

name.description: Official business or company workspace name.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

ownerEmail.description: Email address of the workspace creator.

phone.description: WhatsApp or official business phone number.

metaPixelId.description: Meta Facebook Pixel ID for tracking conversion events.

googleTagId.description: Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID or Google Tag Manager ID.

pixelTrackingEnabled.description: Flag indicating whether pixel tracking and event dispatcher are enabled.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

WorkspaceLead.title: WorkspaceLead
WorkspaceLead.description: Inbound customer leads captured through marketing funnels, WhatsApp, or manual CRM entry.

workspaceId.description: ID of the workspace that owns this lead.

email.description: Contact email address of the prospect.

source.description: Marketing channel source (e.g. Meta Ads, WhatsApp Bot, Organic Website, Demo Request).

status.description: Pipeline stage (new, contacted, qualified, converted, lost).

value.description: Estimated deal monetary value in INR.

notes.description: Internal CRM notes regarding the lead interaction.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the lead was generated.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the lead status was updated.

PixelEvent.title: PixelEvent
PixelEvent.description: Audit log for pixel tracking conversion events fired on client funnels and web forms.

eventName.description: Conversion event name (e.g. PageView, Lead, ScheduleDemo, CompleteRegistration).

eventSource.description: Originating page or interface (e.g. landing_page, demo_modal, pricing).

payloadJson.description: JSON stringified event parameters for pixel audit trail.

pixelDestination.description: Destination channel (e.g. Meta Pixel, Google Tag, Internal Firestore Analytics).

DemoRequest.title: DemoRequest
DemoRequest.description: Live demo and 15-day free trial requests submitted by prospective business clients.

name.description: Full name of the contact person.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the request was submitted.

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user profile records restricted to account owner and verified admins.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Business workspace instances containing CRM settings, contact info, and pixel configuration.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/leads/{leadId}.description: Customer leads captured and managed within a business workspace.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/pixel_events/{.description: Stream of pixel conversion tracking events logged for the workspace.

/demo_requests/{requestId}.description: Inbound demo and 15-day free trial requests for velontrax team.
